requests.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Create a reusable black-and-white cartoon action sprite sheet based on these approved input images. Image 1 is the approved master style sheet, Image 2 is the EXACT character identity/full-body reference, Image 3 is its approved face close-up. Do not redesign the face or character. ONLY change body pose for the requested actions. Always face screen RIGHT in the same slightly side-on view with BOTH eyes visible as the references; never front-facing, back-facing, mirrored, or one-eyed profile. All open eyes are equal-diameter PERFECT ROUND solid black dots, no oval/elongated eyes, no highlights, no eyebrows. Keep nose geometry and placement, head contour, mouth, hair/ear shape, character proportions, smooth constant-width round-ended black outlines, white interior fills. Two thin black contours with white gap for limbs, no extra internal limb lines, paws/shoes wider than limbs. White and black only; no gray shading, texture, hatching, backgrounds, floor, text, labels, grid or notebook lines. GENUINELY transparent alpha outside shapes, OPAQUE WHITE inside bodies, faces, clothes and props. Layout: landscape sheet 1536x1024, EXACTLY TWO isolated complete full-body action sprites side by side, one centered in each half, same head scale, at least 8% outer margins and a generous completely empty central gutter. Every ear, toe, hand, tail and prop fully inside its own half.
Human only: preserve the reference black tousled hair, white T-shirt, black shorts, narrow white arms and legs, white rounded shoes. LEFT sprite: leisurely walking right, naturally swinging arms, one foot ahead. RIGHT sprite: sitting on a minimal simple white stool reading a small open white book held with both hands BELOW the chin, book never overlaps face. Calm slight smile and round open eyes in both. Keep head upright and the exact same face angle; looking toward the book is suggested by body pose, not by turning the face. Critical HUMAN nose is wide shallow open C facing right with two open ROOT endpoints inside the horizontal interval between the two eye CENTER verticals; rightmost eye must remain farther right than both nose ROOT endpoints (not farther right than the protruding nose tip). Nose tip may protrude outward. There is a clear white gap at the upper nose/face junction. Do not change the C into a button nose or a loop.
